subject: The SAM files don't contain "NH tag" for the input of featurecounts

messages.author: 84fdc92960b0146b
messages.subject: The SAM files don't contain "NH tag" for the input of featurecounts
parts:
Hi there,

I am using the featurecounts that you have developed in the analysis of microRNA.

I used Bowtie1 to map the reads and are trying to use featurecounts to count the reads.

The issue is that I plan to use -M parameter to allow the multiple-mapping reads to be counted but realize that the featurecounts uses "NH tag" to find out the multiple-mapping reads and unfortunately, the output SAM files generated by Bowtie1 don't contain "NH tag".

How will featurecounts work under this circumstance?

Many thanks,

Regards,

Dapeng

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: The SAM files don't contain "NH tag" for the input of featurecounts
parts: It is a standard approach to use 'NH' tag to indicate and identify multi-mapping reads (see SAM/BAM specification) and featureCounts follows this approach to identify such reads. You may try to use Subread for your mapping - see Subreads users guide on how to use Subread to map miRNA reads.
